effects.name: Orbit
effects.line: Your own reels circle around you.

effects.name: Couch Wall
effects.line: Your reel covers become a grid on the wall behind you.

effects.name: UI World
effects.line: An app screen fills the frame and you stand in front of it.

effects.name: Freeze Sticker
effects.line: Your freeze frame becomes a die-cut sticker with handwritten notes.

effects.name: Frame Break
effects.line: The video shrinks into a card and you pop out of it.

effects.name: Type Wall
effects.line: Giant words march behind you and swap as you talk.

effects.name: The Stack
effects.line: Data cards with racing bars stack above you.

effects.name: Digital Zoom
effects.line: A slow creep onto your face, then a hard snap on the key word.

effects.name: Sticky Text
effects.line: A tag stuck to your cap or chest that moves with you.

effects.name: Odometer
effects.line: Numbers roll up digit by digit, like a mileage counter.

effects.name: Spotlight
effects.line: The room goes dark, you stay lit, the key words land big.

effects.name: Comment Bubble
effects.line: The comment types itself, posts, and your reply with the link lands.

effects.name: Freeze and Label
effects.line: The picture freezes and labels point at you.

effects.name: Phone Mockup
effects.line: A 3D phone flies in beside you, playing a screen.

effects.name: Checklist
effects.line: Each step ticks off as you say it.

effects.name: Headline Wall
effects.line: The wall behind you fills with headlines.

effects.name: Zoom-Through Cut
effects.line: The camera dives through you into the next shot.

effects.name: Clone
effects.line: More of you pop up beside you, right on your words.

effects.name: Before and After
effects.line: A wipe line turns your raw clip into the edit.

effects.name: Chart Grow
effects.line: A chart draws behind you and takes off on your word.

effects.name: Pointer Callout
effects.line: Cards tied to you by lines that follow you around.

effects.name: Blackout
effects.line: The lights cut on your line and snap back on the next one.

effects.name: Timeline Burn
effects.line: An editing timeline builds in front of you, then catches fire on your word.

effects.name: Pull-Back Reveal
effects.line: The video shrinks into a card in an app window and you watch it get edited.

effects.name: Knockout Tiles
effects.line: Name tiles slam onto the wall behind you and get knocked out one by one.

effects.name: Green Screen
effects.line: You shrink to the bottom and the whole screen becomes what you're talking about.

effects.name: Shatter 3D
effects.line: The frame breaks into floating glass, then shatters to reveal you.

effects.name: Paper Cut
effects.line: The room tears away into a paper collage with ransom-note letters.

effects.name: Doodle Boil
effects.line: A chalk line traces you and doodles draw themselves on your words.

effects.name: Code Scan
effects.line: The picture resolves into code, then back.

effects.name: Word Pile
effects.line: The things you name drop as solid blocks and pile up on a line.

effects.name: Vertigo
effects.line: You stay still while the room stretches away behind you.

effects.name: Inside Out
effects.line: Your body becomes a window into another clip, then the room becomes it.

effects.name: Scene Text
effects.line: A word prints across your real wall, then two big words land on it.

effects.name: Cover Story
effects.line: Your shot becomes a magazine cover while you keep talking.

effects.name: Neon Sign
effects.line: Your phrase lights up as a neon sign on your wall.

effects.name: Spatial Glass
effects.line: Three frosted glass panels float around you for three steps.

effects.name: Rack Focus
effects.line: Focus pulls from you to a title, like a real lens.

effects.name: God Rays
effects.line: The room dims and light breaks out from behind your head.

effects.name: Glass Type
effects.line: One word in thick clear glass on your wall.

effects.name: Depth Scatter
effects.line: Your opening words land at different sizes and fall out of focus.

effects.name: Stat Stack
effects.line: The number you say lands huge, with a tiny line under it.

effects.name: Dot Counter
effects.line: A dot pops in for each thing you are about to cover.

effects.name: Chip Row
effects.line: A pill pops in under your captions for each thing you list.

effects.name: Prompt Box
effects.line: What you tell the AI types itself into a glass box.

effects.name: Serif Flow
effects.line: A dark card draws your process step by step in serif type.
